=== FIRST ===
Lecture: Lesson 1.3.2: Maximum Height, Horizontal Range, and Time of Flight

Section 1: Maximum Height (\\(h_{max}\\)) and Time to Reach Peak (\\(t_B\\))
- Section Identity: Section 1: Maximum Height (\\(h_{max}\\)) and Time to Reach Peak (\\(t_B\\))
- Core Understanding: When a projectile reaches its maximum height (\\(h_{max}\\) or \\(h\\)), its vertical velocity drops momentarily to zero (\\(v_y = 0\\)). Setting \\(v_y = v_0 \sin\theta - gt_B = 0\\) yields the time required to reach peak height: \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\). Substituting \\(t_B\\) into the vertical position equation \\(y(t) = (v_0 \sin\theta)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^2\\) yields the maximum height formula: \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\).
- Visual-First Explanation: A vertical position axis tracking a ascending projectile ball. A dynamic vertical speed gauge decreases to zero at the apex line \\(y = h_{max}\\), locking the peak elevation readout \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\) and stopwatch value \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\).
- Visual Scene Script: A launcher shoots a ball upward at angle \\(\theta\\). The vertical velocity vector arrow \\(v_y\\) continuously shrinks under constant downward gravitational acceleration \\(-g\\). At the exact apex point \\(B\\), \\(v_y\\) collapses to zero, triggering a glowing boundary line \\(y = h_{max}\\). Digital readouts calculate \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\) and \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\) live.
- Dynamic View Blueprint: Interactive sliders for initial speed \\(v_0\\) and launch angle \\(\theta\\), with dynamic height gauge and apex pause animation highlighting \\(v_y = 0\\).
- Visual Learning Outcome: Students grasp that maximum height occurs when vertical velocity \\(v_y = 0\\), deriving peak time \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\) and maximum elevation \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\).
- Concept Check: Is the total velocity of a projectile zero at maximum height? (Answer: No, only the vertical component \\(v_y = 0\\); the horizontal velocity \\(v_x = v_0 \cos\theta\\) remains active).
- Conceptual Summary: At maximum height, \\(v_y = 0\\), giving time to peak \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\) and maximum elevation \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\).
- شرح للجزء بالعامية المصرية: لما المقذوف بيوصل لأعلى نقطة في مساره (Maximum height \\(h_{max}\\))، السرعة الرأسية بتاعته بتنعدم تماماً وتبقى بـ صفر (\\(v_y = 0\\)). من هنا بنقدر نحسب زمن الوصول لأقصى ارتفاع \\(t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\). ولما نعوض بالزمن ده في معادلة المكان الرأسي، بنطلع أقصى ارتفاع: \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\). خلي بالك: عند أقصى ارتفاع السرعة الرأسية بس هي اللي بصفر، لكن السرعة الأفقية شغالة وموجودة!
- القوانين (إن وُجدت): \\(\text{At apex } B: v_y = 0 \implies t_B = \frac{v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\), \\(h_{max} = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\\)
- إسقاط على مثال أو موقف من الحياة اليومية لتثبيت الفهم: لاعب كرة السلة لما يشوط الكورة في قوس عالي ناحية السلة، الكورة بتوصل لأعلى نقطة في الجو وتقف رأسياً للحظة خاطفة قبل ما تبدأ تنزل، النقطة دي هي أقصى ارتفاع \\(h_{max}\\).

Section 2: Total Time of Flight (\\(t_C\\)) and Horizontal Range (\\(R\\))
- Section Identity: Section 2: Total Time of Flight (\\(t_C\\)) and Horizontal Range (\\(R\\))
- Core Understanding: For symmetric projectile motion landing at the same elevation from which it was launched, the total time in the air (time of flight \\(t_C\\)) is exactly twice the time to reach maximum height: \\(t_C = 2t_B = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\). The horizontal range \\(R\\) is the total horizontal distance traveled during time \\(t_C\\): \\(R = v_x \cdot t_C = (v_0 \cos\theta)\left(\frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\right) = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\). The range reaches its theoretical maximum (\\(R_{max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\\)) when \\(\sin(2\theta) = 1\\), corresponding to a launch angle \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\).
- Visual-First Explanation: A 2D trajectory graph showing a symmetric parabolic curve. The flight duration stopwatch reads \\(t_C = 2t_B\\). A horizontal distance ruler expands along the \\(x\\)-axis to measure range \\(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\), expanding to its maximum span when an angle dial is set to \\(45^\circ\\).
- Visual Scene Script: A projectile is fired across horizontal ground. Timer counts up to \\(t_B\\) at peak height, then continues to \\(t_C = 2t_B\\) upon ground impact. A glowing horizontal span line \\(R\\) extends from origin \\((0,0)\\) to impact point \\((R,0)\\). Rotating launch angle \\(\theta\\) reshapes the trajectory: small angles yield flat arches, steep angles yield high narrow arches, and \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\) maximizes horizontal landing distance \\(R\\).
- Dynamic View Blueprint: Interactive angle sweep controller (\\(\theta \in [0^\circ, 90^\circ]\\)) plotting family of parabolic trajectories, with live indicator highlighting \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\) as maximum range \\(R_{max}\\).
- Visual Learning Outcome: Students master calculating total flight time \\(t_C = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\), horizontal range \\(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\), and recognizing \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\) for maximum range.
- Concept Check: At what launch angle \\(\theta\\) is the horizontal range of a projectile maximized for a given initial velocity \\(v_0\\)? (Answer: \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\), because \\(\sin(2 \cdot 45^\circ) = \sin(90^\circ) = 1\\)).
- Conceptual Summary: Total flight time is \\(t_C = 2t_B = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\); horizontal range is \\(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\), which reaches maximum at \\(\theta = 45^\circ\\).
- شرح للجزء بالعامية المصرية: في حالة المقذوفات المتماثلة (اللي بتبدأ وتنتهي عند نفس المستوى الأفقي)، زَمَن الرحلة الكلي في الهوا (Time of flight \\(t_C\\)) بيساوي ضعف زمن الوصول لأقصى ارتفاع: \\(t_C = 2t_B = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\). المدى الأفقي (Range \\(R\\)) هو أقصى مسافة أفقية بتقطعها الكورة، وبيتحسب بضرب السرعة الأفقية الثابتة في الزمن الكلي: \\(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\). والمدى الأفقي ده بيوصل لأقصى قيمة ليه لما تنط أو تحدف بزاوية \\(45^\circ\\)!
- القوانين (إن وُجدت): \\(t_C = 2t_B = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\\), \\(R = v_x t_C = \frac{v_0^2 \sin(2\theta)}{g}\\), \\(\text{Max Range at } \theta = 45^\circ \implies R_{max} = \frac{v_0^2}{g}\\)
- إسقاط على مثال أو موقف من الحياة اليومية لتثبيت الفهم: لاعب الوثب الطويل (Long-jumper) بيحاول يخرج من الأرض بزاوية قريبة من \\(45^\circ\\) وبأقصى سرعة ممكنة عشان يحقق أطول مدى أفقي ممكن \\(R\\) قبل ما ينزل على الرملة.
